duration.text: The Mineral Materials at Central South University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-meidum programs. 2.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 5.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.English proficiency test certificate If any, for English-medium programs; For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 7.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 8.Postgraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Qualification 1. Applicants with an educational background equal to a Master's degree in China 2. present letters of recommendation from two professors 3. and have Band III certificate in HSK, or have studied Chinese for more than one year.
